Sumitomo Chemical.why: Japanese chemical group whose ICT & Mobility Solutions segment supplies semiconductor processing materials (SUMIRESIST photoresists, high-purity chemicals); management credits growing semiconductor demand, mainly AI-driven, for higher shipments
Sumitomo Chemical.evidence: Sumitomo Chemical Q1 FY2027 (08-04-2026): 'Semiconductor-related products saw increased profits, thanks to increase in shipments due to growing demand for semiconductors' (Yamauchi, Managing Executive Officer)

players.product: SUMIRESIST photoresists and high-purity chemicals for front-end semiconductor processes (semiconductor processing materials, ICT & Mobility Solutions)

quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2026 (April-June 2026): sales revenue JPY 578.2 billion, up JPY 52.1 billion year-on-year; core operating income JPY 62.3 billion against JPY 27.7 billion; net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 40.8 billion, up JPY 45.3 billion. Management: the second-best Q1 core operating income and net income on record.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 sales revenue JPY 578.2 billion (+JPY 52.1 billion); core operating income JPY 62.3 billion (prior JPY 27.7 billion)

quarterly_data.signal: ICT & Mobility Solutions Q1 core operating income JPY 13 billion, down JPY 5.3 billion: semiconductor-related products saw increased profits on higher shipments due to growing demand for semiconductors, while display-related products declined (lower polarizing film prices, absence of the prior-year gain on the sale of the large LCD polarizing film business, fewer shipments due to a shortage of semiconductors). Company-wide cost variance was negative JPY 4 billion, mainly from increased fixed costs associated with investments in semiconductor-related products. Management: semiconductor materials have no seasonality and should be roughly flat from Q1 to Q2 although the market itself is growing quite a bit; fixed costs from advance investments in semiconductor-related areas rise from Q2, so profit grows less than shipments this fiscal year; the large-size display business is being wound down.
quarterly_data.figure: ICT & Mobility Solutions core operating income JPY 13 billion (down JPY 5.3 billion); cost variance negative JPY 4 billion

quarterly_data.signal: Management on the business environment: silicon semiconductors will remain solid, mainly driven by AI-related areas; high-purity chemicals and liquid crystals are going to grow steadily this fiscal year; in display, the mobile market will remain sluggish due to increasingly challenging procurement conditions for memory chips, and the memory shortage is starting to affect middle- and low-end products (touch screen sensor panels).

First-half FY2026 forecast (first disclosed): sales revenue JPY 1.17 trillion, core operating income JPY 125 billion, operating income JPY 122 billion, net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 70 billion; core operating income excluding gains on business sales expected to double year-on-year, and the May full-year net income forecast expected to be reached by the end of the first half. The full-year forecast was not revised because of Middle East uncertainty. In ICT & Mobility Solutions, shipments of semiconductor processing materials are expected to increase while display-related materials decline.
quarterly_data.figure: 1H sales revenue JPY 1.17 trillion; core operating income JPY 125 billion; net income JPY 70 billion

quarterly_data.signal: Methionine (feed additives): management said the plant is operating at full capacity of 180,000 tons per year, sold mostly under customer contracts priced with reference to spot prices with a time lag; Agro & Life Solutions Q1 core operating income was JPY 9.6 billion against JPY 2.2 billion, mainly from methionine as Middle East supply-demand tightened. Of the expected JPY 35 billion year-on-year profit increase in Q2, more than half is crop protection and more than JPY 10 billion feed additives.
quarterly_data.figure: methionine capacity 180,000 tons per year at full utilization; Agro & Life Q1 core operating income JPY 9.6 billion

quarterly_data.signal: Essential & Green Materials Q1 core operating income JPY 27.2 billion, up JPY 32.7 billion, on inventory valuation gains in Japan and Singapore and higher equity income from PetroRabigh (JPY 9 billion in Q1, about JPY 17 billion included for Q2); the Q1 inventory valuation gain of JPY 15 billion is expected to reverse in Q2. Sumitomo Pharma segment core operating income JPY 18.8 billion, down JPY 2.2 billion, with higher sales of ORGOVYX and GEMTESA.
quarterly_data.figure: Essential & Green Materials core operating income JPY 27.2 billion; Sumitomo Pharma JPY 18.8 billion
